newsitem.title: UK: EU monetary committee said meeting in Copenhagen.
newsitem.headline: EU monetary committee said meeting in Copenhagen.

text.p: LONDON, May 29 (Reuter ) - Officials of the European Union monetary committee are expected to hold an informal meeting in Copenhagen on Friday, monetary sources said on Thursday.

The sources said the central bank and finance ministry representatives, who work on the detail of European monetary decisions, were to meet in the Danish capital. No official confirmation was immediately available.
While the monetary committee normally meets in Brussels it can meet informally and in private elsewhere. A preparatory meeting could be expected ahead of June's EU summit in Amsterdam.

The Amsterdam summit is expected to be overshadowed by clouds over the timing and shape of economic and monetary union (EMU) generated by the French election and Germany's controversial plan to revalue Bundesbank gold assets. -- London Newsroom 44-171 542-7710
